faqs.a:
Section 112.1. Order
, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"112.1. Order.
Whenever the fire code official finds any work regulated by the Code is being performed
                  in a manner contrary to the provisions of this code or in a dangerous or unsafe manner,
                  the fire code official, with the concurrence of the building official, is authorized
                  to issue a stop work order."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
